text: Hello, I'm Neil.
And I'm Georgie.
Welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 欢迎来到《真正简单英语》。
zh_hant: 歡迎來到《真正簡單英語》。

text: You can find a worksheet and transcript for this episode
zh: 你可以找到本集的练习册和文字稿。
zh_hant: 你可以找到本集的練習冊和文字稿。

text: on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
Hello Neil, how are you doing?
I'm very well, thank you Georgie.
How are you?
Yes, I'm very well, thank you.
Neil, today we're talking about cities.
zh: 尼尔,今天我们聊聊城市。
zh_hant: 尼爾,今天我們聊聊城市。

text: We both live and work in London,
zh: 我们俩都在伦敦生活和工作。
zh_hant: 我們倆都在倫敦生活和工作。

text: which is a very big city.
zh: 那是一座非常大的城市。
zh_hant: 那是一座非常大的城市。

text: It is.
It's a huge city, very busy
zh: 这是一座巨大的城市,非常繁忙
zh_hant: 這是一座巨大的城市,非常繁忙

text: and bustling.
means there's lots of activity, lots of things going on, busy.
zh: 意味着有很多活动、很多事情正在发生,很忙碌。
zh_hant: 意味著有很多活動、很多事情正在發生,很忙碌。

text: Speaking of, what do you like about living in a big,
zh: 说到这个,你喜欢住在大城市的哪些方面?
zh_hant: 說到這個,你喜歡住在大城市的哪些方面?

text: bustling city?
Well, there are lots of good things
about living in a big city.
It's convenient.
It's very convenient.
So there is lots of public transport,
which is sometimes good.
And you can get things that you
need quite easily.
That's very true.
Yeah.
There's also a lot of things to do.
We are lucky in London to have lots of theatres
zh: 我们在伦敦很幸运，有很多剧院。
zh_hant: 我們在倫敦很幸運，有很多劇院。

text: where you can see plays.
There's a really good music scene,
zh: 这里有非常棒的音乐氛围,
zh_hant: 這裡有非常棒的音樂氛圍,

text: so you can watch and listen to a lot of live music.
zh: 你可以观看和聆听很多现场音乐演出。
zh_hant: 你可以觀看和聆聽很多現場音樂演出。

text: If you have no plans on a day,
you can always find plans, spontaneous plans.
zh: 你总能找到计划,即兴的计划。
zh_hant: 你總能找到計劃,即興的計劃。

text: So we are really lucky in that sense.
zh: 从这个意义上说,我们真的很幸运。
zh_hant: 從這個意義上說,我們真的很幸運。

text: Yeah.
And if you like art,
there's all kinds of exhibitions and galleries
zh: 这里有各种各样的展览和画廊
zh_hant: 這裡有各種各樣的展覽和畫廊

text: and museums.
Lots of good things.
But there are obviously some bad things about living in a city, aren't there?
zh: 虽然住在城市里也确实有一些不好的地方，对吧？
zh_hant: 雖然住在城市裡也確實有一些不好的地方，對吧？

text: Yes.
Do you want to tell us some?
Yeah.
Well, it's very noisy
and dirty and busy and expensive.
Yeah.
It's always more expensive in a big city,
especially the capital city.
So you can do all of the things that we
zh: 所以你可以做所有这些事情
zh_hant: 所以你可以做所有這些事情

text: just talked about.
Yeah, but you have to pay.
Yeah, and things like eating out,
especially going for a drink, is a really expensive thing
zh: 尤其是出去喝一杯,是件很费钱的事
zh_hant: 尤其是出去喝一杯,是件很費錢的事

text: to do in a capital city.
I feel like every time I leave the house,
I just spend loads of money,
and that is quite frustrating.
But you have to pay for good times, I guess.
zh: 不过我想,好日子总是要付出代价的。
zh_hant: 不過我想,好日子總是要付出代價的。

text: Yeah.
Have you ever lived in another city apart from London?
zh: 你除了伦敦以外还在别的城市住过吗?
zh_hant: 你除了倫敦以外還在別的城市住過嗎?

text: Yes, I have.
I used to live in Barcelona,
which is quite different to London
zh: 因为这和伦敦很不一样
zh_hant: 因為這和倫敦很不一樣

text: because it has a beach and the sea on one side,
and on the other side it has mountains.
So it's contained by nature,
and you can get to the nature quite quickly,
zh: 你可以很快接触到大自然
zh_hant: 你可以很快接觸到大自然

text: which is really nice.
What about you?
Have you lived anywhere different?
Yeah, I've lived in a few big cities,
zh: 我确实在几个大城市生活过。
zh_hant: 我確實在幾個大城市生活過。

text: a few capital cities, actually.
zh: 其实是好几个首都城市。
zh_hant: 其實是好幾個首都城市。

text: I've also lived in Spain, but in Madrid.
zh: 我也在西班牙住过,不过是在马德里。
zh_hant: 我也在西班牙住過,不過是在馬德里。

text: I lived and worked in Prague,
zh: 我曾在布拉格生活和工作。
zh_hant: 我曾在布拉格生活和工作。

text: and it's a beautiful city.
Yeah.
The architecture looks fantastic.
Nice buildings.
Talking about nice buildings,
I lived in Edinburgh because I did my master's degree there.
zh: 我住在爱丁堡,因为我在那里读的硕士。
zh_hant: 我住在愛丁堡,因為我在那裡讀的碩士。

text: And that has beautiful buildings.
I loved that city.
It has a castle on a big rock in the middle,
zh: 中间有一座建在大岩石上的城堡。
zh_hant: 中間有一座建在大岩石上的城堡。

text: and it's just amazing to look at.
So we've talked about cities we've been to.
zh: 我们已经聊过去过的城市了。
zh_hant: 我們已經聊過去過的城市了。

text: What about the future?
Are there any cities you really want to visit, or maybe even live in?
zh: 你有没有特别想去旅游、甚至想居住的城市?
zh_hant: 你有沒有特別想去旅遊、甚至想居住的城市?

text: Oh, that's an interesting question.
I've never been to Georgia
zh: 我从来没去过格鲁吉亚。

text: or Armenia or that part of the world,
zh: 或者亚美尼亚,或者那个地区
zh_hant: 或者亞美尼亞,或者那個地區

text: so I'm going to say I'd like to go to Tbilisi, in Georgia.
zh: 我想说我想去格鲁吉亚的第比利斯。
zh_hant: 我想說我想去喬治亞的第比利斯。

text: That's a good answer.
I'd love to go there as well.
For me, I'm desperate to go to Latin America.
zh: 对我来说,我特别想去拉丁美洲。
zh_hant: 對我來說,我特別想去拉丁美洲。

text: I really want to go to Rio de Janeiro
at the time when the carnival is there,
zh: 那个狂欢节举行的时候
zh_hant: 那個狂歡節舉行的時候

text: because that sounds really fun and I like to party.
zh: 因为那听起来很好玩,而且我喜欢派对。
zh_hant: 因為那聽起來很好玩,而且我喜歡派對。

text: Let's recap the vocabulary we heard during the conversation,
zh: 我们来回顾一下对话中出现的词汇吧。
zh_hant: 我們來回顧一下對話中出現的詞彙吧。

text: starting with bustling, which means busy,
zh: 以“bustling”这个词开始,它的意思是“繁忙的”。
zh_hant: 以“bustling”這個詞開始,它的意思是“繁忙的”。

text: with lots of people and activity.
We also heard convenient.
If something is convenient, it means it's very easy
zh: 如果某样东西很方便,意思是它非常容易使用。
zh_hant: 如果某樣東西很方便,意思是它非常容易使用。

text: to do it.
For example, there's lots of public transport in London,
zh: 伦敦有很多公共交通工具,
zh_hant: 倫敦有很多公共交通工具,

text: so it's convenient for travel.
And we talked about possible plans for the future using "would like to".
zh: 我们用“would like to”谈论了未来的可能计划。
zh_hant: 我們用“would like to”談論了未來的可能計劃。

text: For example, I'd like to visit Tbilisi in Georgia.
zh: 比如说,我想去格鲁吉亚的第比利斯。
zh_hant: 比如說,我想去喬治亞的第比利斯。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English,
zh: 本期《Real Easy English》就到这里。
zh_hant: 本期《Real Easy English》就到這裡。

text: but we'll be back next week with another conversation
zh: 但我们下周还会带来一场新的对话
zh_hant: 但我們下週還會帶來一場新的對話

text: in Easy English.
And you should check out our series, The London to Edinburgh Challenge.
zh: 你应该去看看我们的系列节目《伦敦到爱丁堡挑战》。
zh_hant: 你應該去看看我們的系列節目《倫敦到愛丁堡挑戰》。

text: We've been talking about Edinburgh today.
zh: 我们今天一直在聊爱丁堡。
zh_hant: 我們今天一直在聊愛丁堡。

text: It's a beautiful place, and you can see it in this series.
zh: 在这部剧里,你能看到这个美丽的地方。
zh_hant: 在這部劇裡,你能看到這個美麗的地方。

text: It's on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
Goodbye for now.
Goodbye.
